}}The '''Durotar Labor Union''' is a group of Goblins that joined the Horde after defecting from the Venture Co. They're eager to prove themselves as capable members of the Horde.

== Reputation ==
[[Vanessa Clang]] has the repeatable engineering material quests to achieve a higher reputation with the Durotar Labor Union. In return for exalted reputation, non-goblin players are able to ride [[rocket car]]s.

Most quests associated with the Durotar Labor Union come from the areas of Blackstone Island, Durotar, [[Stonetalon Mountains]], and [[Dustwallow Marsh]].

==Trivia==
* The Durotar Labor Union is the first original faction that was added to Turtle WoW.
